note: The session's web search budget ran out after eight queries, so most of this part was looked up only at official addresses that could be reached directly; the county, city and school candidates left blank are worth a second pass. Seen and left out on purpose: the Nebraska Examiner voter guide (ages, registrations and earlier posts for Witt, Landers and Tegtmeier; it answers a fetch with 403, so nothing from it could be confirmed); ages are not birth years; a news guide's 'registered Republican/Democrat' is not a past_party record. Party lists naming Witt, Dungan, Vargas, Seliga, Meese, Tegtmeier and Kennedy are already in ballot/lean/ne_endorsements.json, which records that those pages do not say 'endorsed', so no endorsed_by is given here. The current board pages of Sarpy (District 2), Madison and Washington counties do not name Seliga, Reeves or Japp, who are therefore not shown as holding those seats. Dungan's birth year (Wikipedia) is not recorded because he is a sitting legislator with a record page. George Dungan's and Tony Vargas's sites did not resolve for WebFetch but answered the kit's own fetcher. Found by trying likely names, not by search: wittfornebraska.com (it names the candidate and the district). A photographer's site at mattschulte.com is another person and was not used.
